title: Guest ABI ahead of host; skewed world denied fail-closed

unsupported_world_decisions.repair_affordance_label: rebuild extension against component-model 0.2.x or wait for host 0.3.x support

narrative: The guest declares a component-model 0.3.x ABI the host (0.2.x) does not implement. The skewed editor-read@0.2.0 world is denied with a typed guest_abi_range_mismatch decision and a repair affordance; it never enters the negotiated set. The unaffected workspace-read world is admitted. The host fails closed: it denies rather than widening or silently dropping the unsupported world.
